predecessors.name: Maya city-states (Preclassic and Classic)
predecessors.text: Toniná, 13 km east of Ocosingo, Chiapas; the site 'on a platform covering 6 hectares'

ledger.x: 495: the first dated monument ('The dated monuments at Toniná span the period from AD 495 to 909'); the page gives no founding and an 8th-century text mentions a king 'ruling in AD 217' without a name.

15 January 909: 'The last known recorded date at the site is featured on Monument 101'; 'By the time of Ruler 8's successor, Uh Chapat, Toniná was clearly in decline' and the infobox gives 'Abandoned: 10th century AD'.

wars.name: Toniná-Palenque wars
wars.outcome: September 687: Ruler 2 was possibly 'defeat[ed] and captur[ed] by K'inich Kan Balam II of Palenque'; 'in 711, while Ruler 4 was still a child, Toniná gained an important victory over Palenque'; 'around 764 Toniná defeated Palenque in battle'.

wars.name: Toniná-Piedras Negras war
wars.outcome: 'Around 725 Toniná fought a war against Piedras Negras, a city on the north bank of the Usumacinta River, now in Guatemala.'
